bar.label: Leading the class live
bar.frozenSays: Picture paused — the students see what you showed last.
bar.endSays: The students go back to where they were.

screen.wait: The teacher will show something in a moment.
screen.noSeatKey: the key from the link is missing in this browser
screen.problemHolder: Your link could not be opened for the lesson: {why}
screen.problemKey: The teacher is leading, but this browser cannot open the lesson yet — it keeps trying every few seconds.
screen.problemSearch: Checking for a running lesson failed: {why}
screen.roomTeacherAway: the teacher is not connected right now
screen.problemNoClass: The teacher is leading, but this link does not hold the class key (it was not made with the class link). Ask the teacher for a new link to the class.

console.live: You are leading this class live
console.startSays: Every device of the class shows what you show: the map, a slide or a question. Your own tools (the QR code, this console) are not shown.
